title: Doing More with Less: Overcoming Ineffective Long-Term Targeting Using Short-Term Signals
eligible_reason: Targeting with short-term surrogate signals evaluated with the Targeting Operator Characteristic on a randomized experiment (CATE models, surrogate indices). No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: simulation/*.R for Section 5 and Appendix B; empirical application/ate_analysis.R (balance, ATE via lm on treatment and covariates), targeting_short_term.R, targeting_long_term.R (CATE models, surrogate index).
data_files_note: readme.txt: data under NDA; 'our replication analyses are based on synthetic datasets' with larger noise and reduced sample sizes.
data_provenance_note: Synthetic experiment (1,000 customers) and historical (3,000 customers) data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
